name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Take the key, then open the door' is captured by hard Existence(door_open) plus hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), which together force the key to be taken without a redundant Existence(has_door_key). 'After that, try to pick up the box' keeps the order hard (Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up)) while the pickup itself is the preference (soft Existence(target_picked_up)), matching the cue scope. The machine finishes in u3 exactly on door_open with has_door_key, and the soft pickup adds reward without deciding completion.

texts: Take the key before opening the door.
Only after opening the door, pick up the box.
Try to pick up the target box.
